notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hotfix 1.0.1[/h3]

-Fixed a bug where falling off of Big Tree didn't kill player.

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Available on Steam or Itchio[/h3]

At long last, Murdo's Quest has been released.

Murdo's Quest is a 2D Platformer heavily inspired by the Addam's Family game for NES.  It features a free roaming, gothic 2D world.

Play with 100% controller or 100% mouse/keyboard.

notes.title: Releasing Tommorrow!
notes.content:
[h3]Releasing Tomorrow, June 1![/h3]

It's a bit surreal to be releasing my first game.  After many false starts, I wasn't sure it would ever happen.  But, finally, Murdo's Quest is releasing.
